# Sound — thecatcourt, Film 02: the 75 BPM narrated re-cut

**TL;DR** — One score file, `public/audio/thecatcourt-02.mp3`, generated by
`scripts/generate-score-02.sh`. 35.200s, 75 BPM, 44 beats, 43 SFX events + 1 SFX-silent beat.
Beat `n` = `n * 0.8s`. Every SFX keeps the **beat number** it has in `src/reel/sfx.ts`; only
seconds-per-beat changed (0.5 → 0.8). This cut is **narrated** — a voiceover sits over most of
the film, so the bed is deliberately thinner in the midrange than Film 01.
**Verified against:** `scripts/generate-score-02.sh` @ 2026-10-04, ffmpeg n9.0.1.
**Delivered (measured, not targeted):** -13.7 LUFS integrated, -2.1 dBFS true peak, LRA 10.6 LU,
35.200000s, 192 kbps mp3. Master gate in the script re-measures and exits 1 if out of spec.

Everything is synthesised in ffmpeg `lavfi` — no samples, no downloads, no licensing. Every
noise source is seeded, so the file is reproducible.

Film 01 (`scripts/generate-score.sh`, `public/audio/thecatcourt-01.mp3`) is **shipped and
frozen**. Nothing here modifies it.

---

## 1. Timing contract

| | Film 01 | Film 02 |
|---|---|---|
| Tempo | 120 BPM | **75 BPM** |
| Beat | 0.5s / 30 frames @60fps | **0.8s / 48 frames @60fps** |
| Bar (4 beats) | 2.0s | **3.2s** |
| Total (11 bars / 44 beats) | 22.000s | **35.200s** |
| Beat `n` starts at | `n * 0.5`s | **`n * 0.8`s** |
| `VERDICT_STAMP_BEAT` (35) | 17.5s | **28.0s** |

### Delay compensation — absolute, NOT musical
A sound's *perceived hit* lands on the beat, not its file start. Three stems are pre-delayed.
Two of those offsets are tied to the one-shot's own envelope in milliseconds and therefore do
**not** scale with tempo; one is tied to a beat and therefore does.

| Stem | Offset | Scales with tempo? | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| `whoosh` | `beat*800 − **400ms**` | **No** | 0.70s swell peaking at 0.40s — a fixed property of the file |
| `drop` | `beat*800 − **400ms**` | **No** | 0.42s glide, landing impact at 0.40s — same |
| `riser` | `beat*800 − **1600ms**` | **Yes** | It must span 3 beats and resolve on beat+1. 3 beats = 2.4s at 75 BPM (was 1.5s / −1000ms) |

## 3. Per-bar musical arc

| Bar | Beats | Time | Arc |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0–3 | 0.00–3.20 | Hook. Thump + three slams, no pad. Sub drone at 0.30. Kick soft (0, 2, 3.5). |
| 1 | 4–7 | 3.20–6.40 | Charge opens. Drone +0.18 at 3.20s, pad whispers in. Kick on quarters. Hats start on off-eighths. |
| 2 | 8–11 | 6.40–9.60 | Charge closes on the stamp at 8.80s. Still quarters — the sparsest driving bar, cut for VO. |
| 3 | 12–15 | 9.60–12.80 | Exhibit A. Drone +0.14 at 9.60s. Kick subdivides to eighths from 9.60s. Riser builds under 11.20 and resolves on the 12.00 slam. |
| 4 | 16–19 | 12.80–16.00 | Exhibit B. Pad +0.08. Back to quarters for a bar of breath. |
| 5 | 20–23 | 16.00–19.20 | Exhibit C. Pad +0.06. Eighths return and run into the drop at 17.60 and the 18.40 slam — the densest point of the first half. |
| 6 | 24–27 | 19.20–22.40 | **The floor drops.** Drone −0.62 and pad −0.34 at 19.04s; no kick, no hats layer carries weight. Deliberation runs dry: two whooshes and two ticks over near-silence. |
| 7 | 28–31 | 22.40–25.60 | Deliberation tightens. Stamp at 22.40, click, whoosh, and the second riser building from 23.20s. |
| 8 | 32–35 | 25.60–28.80 | **Verdict.** Drone +0.85 / pad +0.40 at 25.52s. Kick hard on eighths. Whoosh wipe → slam, slam → the big stamp at 28.00s. |
| 9 | 36–39 | 28.80–32.00 | Verdict holds. Ticks/clicks over the hard kick, thump docks the block at 31.20. |
| 10 | 40–43 | 32.00–35.20 | Lockup / resolve. Drone −0.35 at 31.92s, pad −0.15 at 32.00s, both decay from 34.4–34.56s. Soft kick returns. Final whoosh at 33.60, SFX-silent 34.40, fade out 35.05–35.20s. |

---

## 4. What changed from the 120 BPM cut, and why

| # | Change | Why |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `msl()` multiplies by `BEAT_MS=800`, not 500 | The whole point. Every beat number is unchanged. |
| 2 | Whoosh/drop offsets stay **−400ms**; riser offset becomes **−1600ms** | The first two are delay compensation for a fixed envelope — absolute milliseconds. The riser's is musical (3 beats), so it scales. Multiplying all three by 1.6 would have put every whoosh peak 240ms late. |
| 3 | Riser rebuilt at **2.4s** (was 1.5s); triad notes enter at 0.0/0.8/1.6s (was 0.0/0.5/1.0) | It must still span three beats and resolve one beat after its shotlist beat. A 1.5s riser at 75 BPM resolves mid-beat and lands nowhere. |
| 4 | Every other one-shot is **byte-identical** to Film 01 | A click is a click at any tempo. Only sustained elements are tempo-dependent. |
| 5 | Kick subdivided to eighths in bars 3, 5, 8, 9 (`x.5` beats) | At 75 BPM a quarter-note kick is 0.8s apart and the bed went limp. Eighths at 0.4s restore the *absolute* pulse rate Film 01's quarters had, in the low end — which is the band narration does not occupy. |
| 6 | Hats kept on off-eighths in **beats** (so half as dense in **time**) and weight cut 0.35 → **0.22** | The main midrange thinning. The hat layer was the busiest thing competing with speech. |
| 7 | Pad mix weight 1.00 → **0.62**; sub weight 1.00 → **1.15**; riser 1.10 → **0.95** | Narration sits in the pad's band (130–392 Hz triad + harmonics). Pull the pad back, replace the lost body with low end that sits under speech rather than on it. |
| 8 | All section-envelope anchors ×1.6 | They are beat positions: floor-drop 11.9 → **19.04s** (beat 24 = 19.2s), verdict return 15.95 → **25.52s** (beat 32 = 25.6s), resolve 21.5/21.6 → **34.4/34.56s**. Ramp lengths scaled too (0.1 → 0.16s etc.) so a ramp stays the same fraction of a beat. |
| 9 | `afade` out 21.85 → **35.05s**; `atrim 0:35.2`; all bed sines `d=35.2` | New length. |
| 10 | `PRE_GAIN` default 1.0 → **2.2** | Not cosmetic — this was a **gate failure**. The narration-safe bed is ~6dB quieter in the midrange, so the same 44 transients sit much further above it: the raw mix came out at PLR 18.4 dB and the first run delivered a true peak of **−0.7 dBFS**, out of spec. Measured sweep: 1.0 FAIL, 2.0 / 2.5 / 3.0 all pass. 2.2 is the lowest drive with margin, chosen to keep the most transient dynamic range that still passes. |
| 11 | Master gate duration check 21.95–22.05 → **35.15–35.25** | Same three-stage loudness chain (two-pass `loudnorm` + delivered-mp3 residual trim), same loudness/true-peak bounds. |

### What did NOT change
The three-stage loudness chain, the `alimiter` ceiling (0.891 ≈ −1 dBFS), the `LN="I=-14:TP=-2.6:LRA=11"`
targets, the mp3 bitrate, every noise seed, and every beat number in `src/reel/sfx.ts`.
